name: Run Webserver
description: Runs a background web service listening on a specified port for incoming HTTP requests.

inputs.name: port
inputs.label: Port Number
inputs.helpText: Network port for the web service to listen on (e.g. 3000, 8080).

inputs.name: cors
inputs.label: CORS Enabled
inputs.helpText: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers for browser requests.
